sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the graph to encode protection coverage—not merely a six-value hazard presence list—for every machinery installation and each linked associated equipment item, with evidence at the required scope. Do not require all six hazards conjunctively with sh:minCount 6/sh:maxCount 6 when the requirement is limited to applicable hazards; represent each applicable controlled hazard and its corresponding coverage relationship.
